context: Add a short trust-label section to contributing-results.md sourced from the SOURCE_TO_TRUST_LABEL table, and state explicitly that vendor-supplied is maintainer-applied and never self-declared on a submission.
description: PR #1021 landed the canonical provenance vocabulary (benchbox/core/results/provenance.py) and propagated vendor-supplied through bundle_publisher.py, hosted-results-contract.md and generate_corpus_inventory.py. docs/contributing-results.md was in that item's only_modify scope but has zero occurrences of vendor-supplied, so the contributor-facing doc never explains the label, who it applies to, or that it is maintainer-applied rather than self-declared.

preserves.behavior: Label strings are described, not redefined - the vocabulary of record stays benchbox/core/results/provenance.py

work_units.evidence: Implemented in PR #2044 (commit 58dda68c4e666ea62068ed8c88e86d4288ce100a). docs/contributing-results.md:158-188 semantically documents the complete vendor-supplied trust label semantics aligned with benchbox/core/results/provenance.py: SOURCE_TO_TRUST_LABEL mapping, maintainer-applied constraint, vendor path protection under results-data/bundles/vendor/, distinct badge, and ranking eligibility.
work_units.summary: Add the trust-label section covering vendor-supplied and its maintainer-applied rule
